title: Vietnamese-Style Braised Pork Belly
description: A hearty and comforting Vietnamese dish made with slow-cooked pork belly, served with a sweet and savory sauce.
instructions: Heat the ca kho sauce in a large Dutch oven over medium heat.
Add the pork belly and cook until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Add the to and bring to a simmer.
Cover the pot and transfer to the oven.
Braise for 2 1/2 hours, or until the pork is tender and easily shreds with a fork.
Remove the pot from the oven and stir in the gooey sugar.
Return the pot to the stovetop and simmer over medium heat until the sauce has thickened slightly.
Season with hearty black pepper to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped fresh herbs if desired.
